title: Prior Authorization Extension Grants
content:
**Utilization Management policy — extension of an approved Prairie Ridge Prior Authorization.**

An extension of an approved authorization moves its end date forward by the extension days of the authorization's Prior Authorization class and adds units granted by extension, never more than the class's extension allotment in one extension.

The units an extension adds are fixed only after the authorization carries the member's extension request stating the additional units asked for.

The units an extension adds are not worked out before the authorization names, as its servicing provider, the in-network provider who will deliver them.

The units an extension adds are not recorded until no other approval of the member in the same class and, for therapy, the same therapy discipline stands approved over dates that overlap the period the extension adds.

## Illustration of the end-date clause (hypothetical)

| Current end date | Class extension days | End date after the extension |
|---|---|---|
| 2031-06-30 | 60 | 2031-08-29 |
| 2031-06-30 | 7 | 2031-07-07 |

The period the extension adds runs from the day after the current end date through the end date after the extension.

## Invocation: `record_extension_d36e0acf`

**Situation of use and capability.** The tool records an extension of one of the member's approved Prairie Ridge Prior Authorization authorizations: it moves the authorization's end date to the new end date given, adds the given units to its total units approved and to its units-remaining balance, and posts one grant entry for those units marked as granted by extension, dated the day it is run. The member and the servicing provider then see the longer approval and the added units.

**How it is invoked.** The agent unlocks `record_extension_d36e0acf` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

- `authorization_id` — the reference number of the approved Prior Authorization being extended, as returned by the prior authorization lookup for the member.
- `units_added` — the units the extension adds, in the authorization's unit basis, written as whole integer units, positive.
- `new_end_date` — the authorization's end date after the extension, written as a calendar date in the format YYYY-MM-DD.

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `authorization_id` | authorization being extended | reference number |
| `units_added` | units the extension adds | whole integer units, positive |
| `new_end_date` | end date after the extension | YYYY-MM-DD |

**Return.** A confirmation sentence stating the grant entry reference (an identifier beginning with `aun_`), the authorization reference, the whole number of units added, the new end date (YYYY-MM-DD), the new total units approved and the new units-remaining balance (whole units). The presence of the grant entry reference shows that the extension was recorded.
